exercises.instruction: Read the short text, then complete the sentences below.
items: This is James Thomas Brown; he has no brothers and sisters. His parents died when he was 20 and they left him their house. He married Julia and they had two children, but unfortunately his wife died two years ago. Recently he has fallen in love with Amy who he has known since they were young. She is the sister of a very good friend of his called Mike, who he likes and trusts.
2 James Thomas Brown is his .............................. name.
5 He has no brothers and sisters so he is an .............................. child.
